name: Six-method matched comparison on higher-density CARLA, Cross, and Roundabout maps
scope: Train and evaluate the three requested baselines and three evidence-selected iterations under matched, additive high-density social traffic while preserving each source map and ego task.

matrix.pairing: For a fixed scenario and training seed, all methods use the same ordered source traffic partition, density multiplier, evaluation seed block, reward, action interface, observation dimensions, and episode limit.
matrix.aggregation: Report every scenario first; then equal-weight scenario macro averages. Report mean and population standard deviation across training seeds without imputing missing jobs.

iteration_selection.eligibility: An iteration must have real closed-loop evidence on at least CARLA and Cross. One-scenario perfect runs are ineligible. Rank eligible variants by equal-weight observed target-scenario success, then collision, then broader target coverage.

selected.boundary: Promotion failed the Cross collision noninferiority gate; selected here as a stress-test candidate, not declared accepted.
Three-seed 100k evidence uses a different historical budget from v4 development; ranking is only a transparent screen.
Seed instability caused development rejection; it wins the success tie with v4.3 only on lower observed collision.

nearest_excluded_tie.reason: Tied v4.1 on observed macro success but had the higher collision rate.

incomplete_latest_excluded.reason: Fresh development matrix had no completed aggregate decision when this protocol was frozen.

carla.rationale: The reconstructed urban task already has 840 motor vehicles/hour plus two pedestrian streams; +35% raises motor demand to 1134 vehicles/hour without turning the short task into immediate insertion gridlock.

cross.rationale: The double-merge corridor receives a 50% social-vehicle increase to stress gap selection at both merges. The source ego departs at 5 seconds, so cloned copies are offset by 8-10 seconds: the frozen source warm-up and ego insertion remain feasible before the additional batch arrives.

roundabout.rationale: The source Roundabout-C task is already the high-traffic variant and begins with a large vehicle batch; +25% avoids measuring pure entry-gridlock instead of policy robustness.

environment_contract.traffic_implementation: Load the frozen source traffic first, an additive versioned social-demand overlay second, and the unchanged ego route last. Cross clones use an 8-10 second offset so no added copy races the source ego's 5-second insertion.
environment_contract.evaluation_partition_rule: Lexicographic source traffic index modulo five equals zero.
environment_contract.carla_partition_boundary: CARLA has one reconstructed traffic file, so source-file train/evaluation disjointness is impossible; episode RNG seeds remain paired.

smoke.evidence_scope: Engineering smoke only; never report as a method result.

comparison.evidence_scope: Matched three-seed high-density comparison; 54 fresh training jobs and 1620 deterministic evaluation episodes.

artifact_contract.missing_value_rule: Missing or failed jobs remain explicit with null metrics; no value may be copied from historical normal-density evidence.
